definitions.explanation: Plants cultivated for ornamental purposes in gardens or yards.
Plants grown in containers or pots.

examples.japanese: {植木|うえき}に{水|みず}をやる。
{植木|うえき}{屋|や}さんに{庭|にわ}の{手入|てい}れを{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I asked a gardener to maintain the garden.

examples.japanese: {植木|うえき}{鉢|ばち}を{買|か}ってきた。
{庭|にわ}の{植木|うえき}を{剪定|せんてい}する。
{玄関|げんかん}に{植木|うえき}{鉢|ばち}を{並|なら}べている。
examples.english: I have potted plants lined up at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {植木|うえき}{市|いち}で{季節|きせつ}の{花|はな}をたくさん{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a lot of seasonal flowers at the plant market.

examples.japanese: {留守|るす}の{間|あいだ}、{隣|となり}の{人|ひと}に{植木|うえき}の{水|みず}やりを{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: While I was away, I asked my neighbor to water my plants.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{植木|うえき}の{手入|てい}れが{趣味|しゅみ}で、{毎朝|まいあさ}{庭|にわ}に{出|で}ている。
examples.english: My grandfather's hobby is tending to the garden plants, and he goes out to the garden every morning.

examples.japanese: マンションのベランダで{小|ちい}さな{植木|うえき}を{育|そだ}てるのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: It's my pleasure to grow small potted plants on the apartment balcony.

notes:
USAGE: Refers to cultivated plants for ornamental purposes, both in gardens and in pots.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{植木|うえき}{鉢|ばち} (flower pot, planter)
・{植木|うえき}{屋|や} (gardener, plant shop)
・{植木|うえき}{市|いち} (plant market/fair)
・{植木|うえき}{職人|しょくにん} (professional gardener)

RELATED:
・{盆栽|ぼんさい} (bonsai)
・{庭木|にわき} (garden trees specifically)
・{観葉植物|かんようしょくぶつ} (foliage plant)

CULTURAL NOTE: {植木|うえき}{市|いち} (plant markets) are traditional seasonal events in Japan.
